## Summary

**Issue:** Class methods from nested classes can't be used as `Field.default` — migrations serialized `Profile.Capability.default` as `appname.models.Capability.default`, which fails at migrate time.

**Cause:** In `FunctionTypeSerializer.serialize()` (`django/db/migrations/serializer.py`), the bound-classmethod branch built the path from `klass.__name__`, which drops nesting — a classmethod on a nested class produced `module.Capability.default` instead of `module.Profile.Capability.default`.

```diff
-            return "%s.%s.%s" % (module, klass.__name__, self.value.__name__), {
+            return "%s.%s.%s" % (module, klass.__qualname__, self.value.__name__), {
```
`__qualname__` preserves the full nesting (`Profile.Capability`), and for top-level classes it equals `__name__`, so existing behavior is unchanged.
